profile_text.body:
Ericsson LM Telephone Co is a public company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, trading under the ticker ERIC. Its website is ericsson.com. The company describes itself as powering the networks that connect billions, working across 5G, AI-driven automation, and cloud.

On its own site, Ericsson says it helps providers and enterprises unlock what connectivity can do, and it markets secure, reliable enterprise connectivity that unites 5G, AI, and cloud. It says it offers advanced 5G capabilities, network slicing, orchestration, and AI-driven tools, and it presents a perspective on 6G as an intelligent fabric connecting people and machines through mobile, cloud, and AI systems. The site also discusses Open Radio Access Network transformation, citing AT&T as having laid the foundation for an open, disaggregated, and programmable network through that work.

The record held for the company lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its profile lists a CIK of 0000717826, an organization type of public company, and for-profit status.
